item.title: UMich study creates a digital AI copy of patient brain tumors to evaluate metabolic therapy potential
item.description: A University of Michigan study published Jan. 6 used machine learning to create a digital twin replica of gliomas to shed light on the metabolic pathways activated by brain tumors.
